# Scenario: proxyNetworkMTU and projectNetworkMTU from .apinfra apply independently
# to apinfra_proxy_net and <project>_net; routing through the proxy still works.

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: network mtu overrides'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='

docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-mtuov-web

exec sh -c 'mtu=$(docker network inspect -f "{{index .Options \"com.docker.network.driver.mtu\"}}" apinfra_proxy_net); echo "proxy_mtu=$mtu"; test "$mtu" = "1400"'
exec sh -c 'mtu=$(docker network inspect -f "{{index .Options \"com.docker.network.driver.mtu\"}}" apinfra_e2e-mtuov_e2e-mtuov_net); echo "project_mtu=$mtu"; test "$mtu" = "1280"'

grep 'com.docker.network.driver.mtu' $HOME/infra/docker-compose.yml
grep '1400' $HOME/infra/docker-compose.yml
grep 'com.docker.network.driver.mtu' $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-mtuov/docker-compose.yml
grep '1280' $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-mtuov/docker-compose.yml

exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9987/
stdout 'MTU-OK'

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main
proxyNetworkMTU=1400
projectNetworkMTU=1280

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-mtuov
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9987
      target:
        service:
          name: web
          port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-mtuov/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=MTU-OK"]

-- .env --
